baymax-armoured.glb is converted from "Armored Baymax (from Disney's Big Hero 6)" by DoodleNotes1,
http://www.blendswap.com/blends/view/76636, licensed Creative Commons Attribution 3.0
(http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0). Marked as fan art: non-commercial use only.
Changes: exported to glTF with modifiers applied, cloth simulation removed, subdivision reduced,
textures downscaled; posed at runtime by the project's own rigs.
